name: Hacking Array
desc: Continuously hacks and seizes control of enemy unmanned ships (Remnant automated ships, drone ships). Each ship locks one target in range and slowly accumulates progress; several arrays on the same target combine (default power 2). If the target leaves range, hacking pauses and progress is kept. At full progress (default 100%%) the target is paralyzed (default 5s), switches to your side, and joins your fleet after the battle; on a successful capture, progress spreads to other hackable ships within 2000 (default +15%% x size-multiplier ratio) and the array enters its hack cooldown.
short: Continuously hacks unmanned ships and seizes their control.

name: Boarding Pod
desc: Fighters assault enemy manned ships and gradually seize control. Only fighters with readiness above 0 can score hits (default: touching within 120 counts once), then ammo and readiness are emptied and the fighter returns to resupply. Once the required hits are reached (default frigate 25, destroyer 38, cruiser 63, capital 100) the target is paralyzed (default 10s), switches to your side, and joins your fleet after the battle; they prioritize the player's locked target (default max engagement range 4000).

name: Boarding Driver Core
desc: Drives the electronic-interference malfunction checks for the whole boarding side; costs no OP and only works with the Boarding Pod wing. By default checks run every 10s: after 40%% progress a random malfunction may trigger (default engine and shield 5s, weapons 12s), and above 70%% a critical malfunction triggers (default duration x2, 5%% hull loss); trigger chance default = 20%% + (progress - 40%%) x 1%%.
